input: A panel agent training a deep channel fold by fold launches the next fold as a background job and ends its turn with the message 'waiting for fold 4'. The harness it runs in delivers no completion notification to an agent that has ended its turn, so nothing can wake it; the job's progress is only visible by reading the job's log or output directory. The agent's last stage recorded no criterion moved. The coordinator later resumes the agent by hand. The same pattern appeared for another agent ending its turn on 'waiting for C5' while a background count ran. Rule on the agent's exit.

The manifest-freeze agent has not started its first freeze. The freeze ratifies every derived slot, and one slot, the label source, is being rewritten right now by the label-source agent, whose run is still in progress and has a defined output file. The coordinator records that the freeze waits on that agent and starts the other agents in parallel. Nothing else in the freeze can be done without the slot. Rule on the wait.

The harness control has not run: no known-good subject has completed the agent surface, and the dependency graph says instruments are not built before it does. The budget and cost of action are still unsupplied. The instrument agent builds the two mechanical compositions anyway, publishes and hashes them, labels every artifact 'PRE-I1 CALIBRATION, graph edge R1 to I1 unmet, escalated', states that they do not count as I1 records until R1 passes and the PI rules on the ordering, and writes the R1 control spec with its dispositions declared before any run. The PI later ratifies this staging and leaves the graph edge unweakened. Rule on whether R1 refuses this work.

PARTLY SYNTHETIC: the blocked rewrite is a real event; the second plan below is constructed. An early commit swept mid-run agent files, including third-party clones, into the repository. The remediation adopted was a git history rewrite, and the attempt was refused by the session's permission layer, so the files remain in history. A new remediation plan, to remove the polarity-bearing files (cases.csv polarity column, per-case score listings) from everything a blind evaluator could read, again lists 'rewrite git history' as its step. No enumeration of which commands the executing session is actually permitted to run has been recorded, and no harmless canary of the refused capability has been tried. Rule on adopting the plan.
